description: The donut chart illustrates the composition of the Darija Open Dataset Version 2, broken down into six distinct data categories, each represented by a colored segment with its corresponding count. The largest segment, colored yellow, represents “Translated Sentences” with 45,387 entries. The second largest, in green, corresponds to “Pending Translations” at 43,000. The blue segment indicates “Extra + Augmented Data” totaling 30,000. The orange segment, labeled “Syntactic Roles (e.g., Verbs, Nouns, Adjectives),” accounts for 23,108 entries. Two much smaller segments are visible: a dark purple slice for “Semantic Categories (e.g., Food, Economy)” and a reddish-orange slice for “Moroccan Names,” both appearing negligible in comparison to the others, though their exact counts are not labeled on the chart. A legend to the right matches each color to its category, and the chart uses a 3D effect with a central hole, visually emphasizing the relative proportions of each data type within the dataset.
